description: Mainnet transaction whose preconditions are PRECOND_V2 (CAP-0021) with every field at its default except the time bounds: no ledger bounds, no minimum sequence number, min_seq_age 0, min_seq_ledger_gap 0 and no extra signers. The hash covers the PRECOND_V2 arm. SDKs that choose the arm from the field values re-encode it as PRECOND_TIME and compute a hash the network does not know (lightsail-network/java-stellar-sdk#844, Beans-BV/dotnet-stellar-sdk#281, Soneso/stellar_flutter_sdk#299, fixed in Soneso/stellar-php-sdk#222). The transaction failed (path payment, too few offers); a failed transaction is still in the ledger under this hash. Its operation source differs from the transaction source.

core_version_and_commit.basis: UNVERIFIED: a mainnet ledger at protocol 22 from the public data lake; the data-lake emitter does not publish its core build

generator_version: none (historical capture from the public Galexie data lake; found by the mainnet sweep, docs/evidence/mainnet-sweep/)

xdr_json.why: every V2 field except time_bounds is at its default, but the arm is v2

expected_state_changes_or_participants.indexer_must: hash the envelope bytes as they are; never rebuild the preconditions from their values, because PRECOND_V2 and PRECOND_TIME with the same time bounds hash differently
expected_state_changes_or_participants.note: the transaction failed, so its TransactionMeta v4 has no per-operation entries; op_contract_event_counts is therefore empty, not [0]

validation_evidence.check: rs-stellar-xdr strict decode and byte-exact re-encode
ledger header hash recomputed from header bytes and matched to the recorded ledger hash
validation_evidence.method: ledgerwitness verify; ledger hash independently read from SDF's history archive (generators/datalake-sweep/archive-hash.mjs 55000000). Horizon mainnet returns HTTP 410 for this ledger

validation_evidence.check: scp_value.tx_set_hash and tx_set_result_hash recomputed from the artifact
header signed by a pinned mainnet validator
every envelope hashes under the declared passphrase to a processed result

validation_evidence.method: not applicable to network captures: core goldens are produced by core's own test suite under its test passphrase; see docs/spec/normalization.md

validation_evidence.check: the transaction hash is the network's
validation_evidence.method: tx_processing[54].result.transaction_hash, committed to by the header's tx_set_result_hash; the envelope hashes to it under the mainnet passphrase (ledgerwitness verify)

validation_evidence.check: no second copy of the ledger
validation_evidence.method: SDF runs no public mainnet RPC; the data-lake copy is the only artifact, so the meta is trusted to that emitter

license_or_provenance_notes: Public mainnet ledger data from the public Galexie data lake (AWS Open Data, aws-public-blockchain). The focus transaction was submitted by a third party.
